name: sidebar-animated
title: Sidebar (animated)
description: A shadcn-style application sidebar with grouped navigation, a project list and a user footer. A single rounded highlight slides from item to item, and the panel can collapse to a narrow icon rail.
use: A dashboard or app shell needs persistent navigation that can collapse to icons to give content more room.
avoid: It is built for a desktop app shell with grouped menus and a set width, so a marketing site or phone layout fits poorly.
a11y: Reduced motion is respected and the collapse has a keyboard shortcut, but collapsed items rely on composed tooltips to keep their names. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A tall dark panel on the left lists grouped navigation in small white and grey text with tiny icons, a project section, and a user row at the bottom. It sits beside a dark dashboard with a slim top bar, three stat cards and a large empty panel.
behaves: Moving between menu items slides one rounded grey highlight from the old row to the new one. Toggling the sidebar collapses it smoothly to a narrow icon-only rail and expands it back; the main content widens as it goes.
customise: Open state, default open and hover animation are provider props; the menu groups, projects and user row are composed by you as children, and widths are CSS variables.
weight: moderate: Tracks every menu item with a mutation observer and animates one highlight plus the collapse.
